intro: Between 22 April and 5 August 2026, ZCyberNews published 18 articles under the Unit 42 tag, covering 14 high-severity and 2 critical incidents. Threat actors CL-STA-1062, Gremlin Stealer, and LockBit were observed across these reports. Affected sectors included technology, software development, enterprise, financial services, and government, with impact reported globally and across Central, North, and South America, as well as South Asia. The coverage spans a range of campaigns and incidents, reflecting the breadth of activity tracked by Unit 42 during this period.
